<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<LightningMessageChannel xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <description>Lightning Message Service channel for Work Item component communication</description>
    <isExposed>true</isExposed>
    <lightningMessageFields>
        <description>The action being performed (workItemUpdated, workItemCreated, workItemDeleted, workItemExpanded, workItemCollapsed)</description>
        <fieldName>action</fieldName>
    </lightningMessageFields>
    <lightningMessageFields>
        <description>The ID of the Work Item affected</description>
        <fieldName>workItemId</fieldName>
    </lightningMessageFields>
    <lightningMessageFields>
        <description>The ID of the Project containing the Work Item</description>
        <fieldName>projectId</fieldName>
    </lightningMessageFields>
    <lightningMessageFields>
        <description>Map of field changes (field API name to new value)</description>
        <fieldName>changes</fieldName>
    </lightningMessageFields>
    <lightningMessageFields>
        <description>The complete Work Item wrapper data</description>
        <fieldName>workItemData</fieldName>
    </lightningMessageFields>
    <masterLabel>Work Item Event Channel</masterLabel>
</LightningMessageChannel>
